title: Google says 75% of new code created inside the company is now generated by AI and reviewed by human engineers, up from 50% last fall (Hugh Langley/Business Insider)
summary: Hugh Langley / Business Insider: Google says 75% of new code created inside the company is now generated by AI and reviewed by human engineers, up from 50% last fall — - Three-quarters of new code at Google is being generated by AI, the company said. — The number has been steadily increasing as the company pushes staff to adopt AI tools.
